research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: May Mobility is researching methods and systems for impact-based operation of an autonomous agent, feasibility-based operation of an autonomous agent, and conditional operation of an autonomous agent that select and evaluate driving policies from sensor inputs. They develop tracking by a vehicle, predicting external agent behavior, and dynamically updating an environmental representation, supported by an autonomous vehicle safety platform, remote assistance, risk assessment, dynamic policy curation, multimodal safety operations, and calibration of infrastructure devices.

overview_description.description: May Mobility specializes in autonomous vehicle technology development and deployment. The company's technology studies the city's traffic and commuter flow, identifying bottlenecks and gaps in the current public transit schema to design the optimal routes for communities. The company also offers a fleet operation service and provides daily transit by deploying autonomous shuttles to reduce human error in driving, reduce pollution, and create greater economic benefit for communities and riders, enabling public transportation systems to create a safer, greener, more efficient environment.

about_short_description.short_description: May Mobility is a manufacturing firm that designs and develops autonomous technology vehicles for self-driving transportation solutions.

product.name: May Mobility Autonomous Driving System
product.description: An autonomous driving platform combining a predictive world model, multi-policy reasoning engine, sensor stack and drive-by-wire controls to operate vehicles in real-time across varied road environments.

product.name: Turn-Key Autonomous Transit Service
product.description: A managed autonomous vehicle deployment that combines vehicles, operations, ongoing support, community engagement, software updates and maintenance for transportation partners.

product.name: Autonomous City Transit Solutions
product.description: Autonomous on-demand and circulator services for cities and transit agencies, focused on first- and last-mile connections, underserved areas and gaps in existing public transportation.

product.name: Autonomous Ride-Hail Services
product.description: Autonomous ride-hail transportation delivered through mobility platforms and local service zones, including May Mobility’s preview service in Atlanta through Lyft.

product.name: Commercial Autonomous Mobility Solutions
product.description: Autonomous vehicle services for college and commercial campuses, airports, healthcare centers and other private sites, supporting passenger shuttles and potential middle-mile delivery.
